superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Ne mogu da tretiram Observerov razmak u prijemu kao razmak u merenju: SEPA je poslednji put primljena pre 30 min, a građanski senzori pre 10 min, ali ta starost prijema ne potvrđuje istovremeno uzorkovanje. Odbacujem i svaku priču o ponovnom otvaranju Donjeg grada: prikaz slobodnih mesta promenio se sa 0 na 217, ali izvor ne daje vreme merenja niti status rampe. [F2][F10][F11][F12]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I cannot treat Observer's reception gap as a measurement gap: SEPA last arrived 30 min ago and citizen sensors 10 min ago, but those reception ages do not establish simultaneous sampling [F2][F10]. I also reject any reopening story at Donji grad: displayed free spaces changed from 0 to 217, but the source supplies no measurement time or ramp status [F11][F12].
